items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I was playing in the Al Jays... Come on, Montutti, what's the matter? ... Come on, hit that drum, man.

ctx.x: You and Johnny? Mm-hmm. What'd you fight about? You and Johnny say, start the kid and get the best of one another. They call me that Montutti, you know, and I didn't want them to call me that. I was playing in the Al Jays, a funeral for the odd fellas. There was twelve of us. And I'm back there, playing the bass drum. Come on, Montutti, what's the matter? I said, who you talking to? Come on, hit that drum, man. You're going to be tired. I'll be arguing over there, that guy.
